nodes.label: rice_records RLS posture (deny-all)
nodes.rationale: RLS enabled with no policy and privileges revoked from anon and authenticated - deny-all until the card owning the role-specific v_* view lands a SELECT policy. Reads through the view, writes through a SECURITY DEFINER fn_* (ADR-002, ADR-004).

edges.source_location: alter table public.rice_records enable row level security
